title: VPN connectivity intake
steps: Confirm affected users, onset time, and whether another connection works.
Collect the exact error and approved VPN client version.
Send evidence to Network Support; do not change firewall or access policy.

title: Email delivery intake
steps: Confirm whether sending, receiving, or both are affected.
Collect the error and time without passwords or message content.
Check the approved service status source when connected.

title: Device issue intake
steps: Record the device asset identifier and symptoms.
Ask whether another device or printer works.
Send evidence to Desktop Support; do not erase or reset the device.
